raw_text: How a Deepfake Audio of the PM Almost Derailed India's Reservation Debate. A sophisticated AI-generated audio clip mimicking the Prime Minister's voice spread across WhatsApp and Telegram during the 2024 election campaign, fabricating statements about abolishing caste reservations. Multiple fact-checking organizations confirmed the clip used VALL-E style voice cloning with spectral artifacts detectable at 8-12kHz. The incident has prompted calls for regulation of AI voice synthesis tools ahead of future elections.
